query: What are the steps to apply for the position of a Tamil Nadu Police dog handler?
reference_answer:
Tamil Nadu Police Dog Handler Positions:
To apply, visit the Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board (TNUSRB) website for notifications. Meet the eligibility criteria, fill out the online application, and appear for the written exam and physical tests.
answer: To apply for the position of a Tamil Nadu Police dog handler, you need to pass written and physical tests, undergo a background check, and attend an interview. [Document 1]
